independent_check.deletion_partition: For an original leaf v with support s, an independent set either omits v, contributing I_(T-v), or contains v, in which case it omits s and contributes z I_(T-{v,s}). Thus I_T(z)=I_(T-v)(z)+z I_(T-{v,s})(z).
independent_check.rank_identity: Writing i_j(G)=0 outside the nonnegative feasible ranks, the coefficient of z^j in z I_(T-{v,s}) is i_(j-1)(T-{v,s}). Subtracting the coefficient at j from that at j+1 gives Delta_j(T)=Delta_j(T-v)+Delta_(j-1)(T-{v,s}) for every integer j.
independent_check.sign_consequence: At j=x(T), Delta_x(T)<0. Since the two integer terms sum to this negative integer, at least one is negative. The argument is per original leaf, so leaves sharing a support remain distinct tags.

counterexample_arithmetic.eligible_rank_guard: x+2<=p holds with equality; 3p<2alpha+1 fails since 9 is not less than 7.

scope_limit: This verifies only the identity and rank-x alternative. The K_(1,3) row refutes the stated unguarded transfer but is not an eligible primary counterexample. No eligible cross-rank transfer, selector characterization, or full aggregate conclusion follows.
